patch_list: Every store item — gold packs, skins and remove ads — is granted the moment you tap Buy. No Google Play payment sheet ever opens and nothing is charged.
Fixes the native purchase result so every store purchase (gold packs, skins, remove ads) is granted on device — without depending on the Java bridge handshake.
Removes all ads. Reward videos now give you the prize instantly — no watching needed.
Loads the unlimited money save into the game the first time you open it.
Packs the special save file (unlimited coins & gems, everything unlocked) inside the app.
